**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's heavy pieces become loose and undefended, especially near the king, look for checking moves that win material. Your queen on f3 could capture the rook on a8 with check—forcing Black to block or move. After any block, you recapture with check again, winning more pieces. Train yourself to scan for undefended enemy pieces whenever you calculate checks.
